event: 2026 ILCA SENIOR EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
facts: GRE 223502 was controlled by the Technical Committee at the finishing line after race 5, bronze fleet.
Technical Committee found the free end of the vang attached to the centreboard retention shock cord.
After equipment inspection GRE 223502 tied the end of the vang correctly.
Attaching the free end of the vang to the centerboard retention shock cord may provide an advantage, although the advantage is not certain.
Attaching the free end of the vang to the centerboard retention shock cord could possibly compromise safety, although this is not certain.
conclusions: By having the free end of the vang attached to the centreboard retention shock cord GRE 223502 broke class rule 3. b) x
decision: Using the World Sailing Discretionary Penalty Guidelines for Boats & Support Persons a starting penalty of 20% was decided (Band 2).
There were no circumstances to justify decreasing the penalty. There were no circumstances to justify increasing the penalty.
The penalty given to GRE 223502 is 20% discretionary penalty, calculated using the method describe in RRS 44.3(c ) and applied to race 5, but not worse than the score for DNF.
